business_summary.text: Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores is a merchant miner of manganese and iron ore in Karnataka, with forward integration into ferroalloys, coke and, since November 2024, specialty steel through Arjas Steel.

call_points.text: Beneficiation plant at mines, capex ₹285 Cr, expected commissioned in Q2FY28 to improve ore quality and realisations.
Downhill Conveyor System completed and capitalised; commercial operations targeted by Q2FY27.
New brand architecture under 'Royal Sandur'; incorporating Royal Sandur Hospitality and Royal Sandur Academy, evaluating medical devices.
FY27 iron ore to use the full 4.45 MTPA limit, plus sale of 0.327 million tonnes of approved incidental ore.
Downhill Conveyor System at the mines expected operational within H1FY27.
Coke capacity contracted for FY27 as well, ensuring continuity from the two operating batteries.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share, subject to AGM approval.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates the ₹0.50 final dividend recommended on 7 May 2026

call_points.text: FY26 coke realisations were muted, with prices bottoming in Q2 and Q3; April domestic benchmarks improved.
Ferroalloys production improved each quarter of FY26; management sees initial signs of recovery.
Arjas Steel Q4 saw notable production and sales growth; management expects stronger FY27 performance.

operating_notes.text: Karnataka HC dismissed Sandur Manganese's writ petition against the ₹131.25 Cr compensatory afforestation demand by the DCF.
FY26 exceptional item of ₹32.27 Cr relates to the compensatory afforestation demand; the Karnataka High Court dismissed the company's writ petition against the ₹131.25 Cr demand in May 2026.
FY26 paid-up capital rose to ₹486.1 Cr from ₹162.04 Cr after a bonus issue; EPS fell to ₹13.51 from ₹29.02.
FY26 manganese ore sales rose 93% YoY and iron ore production 14% YoY, both highest-ever; iron ore sales rose only 2% YoY.
Q4FY26 average realisations: manganese ore ₹6,935/t, iron ore ₹2,834/t, ferroalloys ₹67,773/t, coke ₹21,432/t, steel ₹70,361/t.
Coke oven utilisation was ~46% with 2 of 4 batteries operational; the same capacity is contracted for FY27.
Manganese ore sales 0.97 lakh tonne in Q1FY27 at ₹7,954/tonne, up 15% QoQ.
Iron ore sales 9.64 lakh tonne in Q1FY27 at ₹3,095/tonne, up 9% QoQ.
Ferroalloys sales 16,292 tonne in Q1FY27 at ₹71,005/tonne, up 5% QoQ.
Wholly owned subsidiary Royal Sandur MedTech Private Limited leased 6.2 acres of land for 33 years at AMTZ, Visakhapatnam to set up a medical devices manufacturing unit.

timeline.summary: Karnataka High Court dismissed Sandur Manganese's writ petition against the ₹131.25 Cr compensatory afforestation demand.
National Company Law Tribunal approved the voluntary liquidation and dissolution of wholly owned subsidiary Sandur Pellets Private Limited on 29 April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,511.39 Cr (+14.4% YoY), net profit ₹236.28 Cr (+51.0% YoY).
Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited’s Board, chaired by Neha Thomas (ICSI A60853), recommended ₹0.50 final dividend per equity share for FY2026 on May 7, 2026.

Sandur's Q4FY26 investor presentation reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,163 Cr (+61% YoY) and PAT of ₹658 Cr (+40%), standalone net debt free after redeeming ₹423 Cr of NCDs, and a recommended ₹0.50 final dividend.
Bahirji Ajai Ghorpade confirmed on 1 April 2026 no new encumbrances on 36,07,76,274 shares held by promoters, members of Promoter Group, and PAC.
CRISIL revised Sandur Manganese's long-term bank facilities rating outlook to Positive from Stable and reaffirmed 'Crisil A+' on reduced limits of ₹582 Cr.
Sandur Manganese's subsidiary signed a 33-year lease for 6.2 acres at AMTZ Visakhapatnam for its medical devices unit.
